# Zircon Dental & Implant Clinic — Full Reference

## About
Zircon Dental & Implant Clinic (trading also as Zircon Dental & Implant Studio) is a dental clinic in Wakad, Pune, Maharashtra, India, providing dental implants, cosmetic dentistry, root canal treatment, orthodontics, oral surgery, and child dentistry. The clinic has been operating since 2009.

## Services (Treatments)

### Dental Implants
Single tooth implants, implant-supported bridges, and full-arch solutions (All-on-4/All-on-6). Indicative price range: ₹25,000–₹50,000 per implant. URL: https://zircondentalpune.com/treatments/dental-implants

### Immediate Load Implants
Same-day implant placement with a fixed temporary crown, for eligible patients assessed via CBCT scan. Indicative price range: ₹30,000–₹2,50,000 depending on scope. URL: https://zircondentalpune.com/treatments/immediate-load-implants

### Advanced Implants
All-on-4, All-on-6, zygomatic implants, and full mouth rehabilitation for patients with significant bone loss or complete tooth loss. Indicative price range: ₹4,50,000–₹8,00,000. URL: https://zircondentalpune.com/treatments/advanced-implants

### Root Canal Treatment
Single-visit and multi-visit root canal therapy using rotary endodontics. Indicative price range: ₹5,000–₹20,000. URL: https://zircondentalpune.com/treatments/root-canal

### Smile Design
Digital Smile Design, porcelain veneers, and composite bonding. Indicative price range: ₹5,000–₹1,50,000. URL: https://zircondentalpune.com/treatments/smile-design

### Teeth Whitening
In-office LED whitening and take-home kits. Indicative price range: ₹8,000–₹20,000. URL: https://zircondentalpune.com/treatments/teeth-whitening

### Crowns & Bridges
Zirconia, E-Max, and PFM crowns; dental bridges. Indicative price range: ₹5,000–₹20,000. URL: https://zircondentalpune.com/treatments/crowns-bridges

### Orthodontics
Metal braces, ceramic braces, clear aligners, lingual braces. Indicative price range: ₹30,000–₹2,00,000. URL: https://zircondentalpune.com/treatments/orthodontics

### Oral Surgery
Extractions, wisdom tooth removal, bone grafting, sinus lift, jaw surgery. Indicative price range: ₹3,000–₹2,00,000. URL: https://zircondentalpune.com/treatments/oral-surgery

### Child Dentistry
Pediatric check-ups, fluoride treatment, tooth-colored fillings, pulpotomy, space maintainers, emergency pediatric care. Indicative price range: ₹500–₹10,000. URL: https://zircondentalpune.com/treatments/child-dentistry

## Payment
Cash, credit/debit cards, UPI, bank transfer. EMI options available on select treatments through banking partners, subject to bank approval.
